extracted.name: Monday night burgers & slaw
extracted.description: Sit down to an easy weeknight dinner of grilled vegan burgers served with a carrot and cabbage slaw. Use any plant-based patty for a speedy meal, ready in just 20 minutes
ingredient_lines: small handful of rocket or spinach
¼ cabbage (white, red, sweetheart or spring greens), finely sliced
4 tbsp vegan mayonnaise plus extra to serve
small handful of chives, parsley or coriander finely chopped
instruction_lines: Heat the grill to medium-high. Put the Tesco Plant Chef Meat-Free Burgers on a baking tray and grill for 4-5 mins each side until golden and crisp. Toast the buns cut-side up alongside the burgers on the tray for the last 2-3 mins.
Meanwhile, toss the slaw ingredients with some seasoning. Taste, and add a little more lemon or mustard, if you like.

Spread a little mayo on the burger bun bases, add a tomato slice and a burger. Add a spoonful of the slaw. Top with some rocket or spinach, and add the burger lids. Serve with the remaining slaw on the side.
